methodology.scope: Sequential local production processes with the same dataset restored into each backend. The complete workload includes process startup, HTTP reads and writes, App Live and shutdown. Idle RSS sums only the server process tree. External PostgreSQL runs separately. The fixture does not measure fleet throughput or a deployment restart. Application payload digests match across all 130 invocations. Rust bundled PostgreSQL includes its private database processes in server-tree RSS and has no paired Node owner.
methodology.hostLoad: Cells ran sequentially on a shared macOS host with variable load from local QA. Per-cell load measurements are included.

externalPostgresReadTradeoff.interpretation: Both individual reads remain slower. Accept this scoped populated local workload with the observed latency tradeoff: the 50-message page, durable writes, eight-client mixed-read throughput, startup and complete workload improved. The paired sample does not establish fleet performance.
